title_en: 83 The Little Mouse with Eyes Covered
page_text_ocr_zh:
从此，大伙儿都爱上了这个“拔河马”活动，不过他们用一根绳子代替了河马先生和椅子，因为他们不能让河马先生老卡在椅子里。
大伙儿把这项有趣的活动叫作拔河马比赛。
河马先生呢，他挥舞着小旗，是个当然的裁判。

2. 蒙上眼睛的小老鼠

008
page_text_en:
From then on, everyone loved this 'tug-of-war with the hippo' activity, but they used a rope instead of Mr. Hippo and the chair, because they couldn't let Mr. Hippo get stuck in the chair all the time.
Everyone called this fun activity the 'Hippo Tug-of-War Competition'.
As for Mr. Hippo, he waved a small flag and was, of course, the referee.

2. The Little Mouse with Eyes Covered

008
summary_zh: 本页讲述了大家用绳子代替河马先生和椅子进行‘拔河马’比赛，河马先生则担任裁判。右侧页面标题为‘蒙上眼睛的小老鼠’，预示下一个故事。

xiǎo lǎo shǔ cōngcōng hé huǒ bàn men zài wū lǐ wánzhuō
Little mouse Congcong and his friends were playing hide-and-seek inside the house.

huǒ bàn men yòng bù bǎ xiǎo lǎo shǔ de yǎn jīng méng le
The friends covered Little Mouse's eyes with a cloth.
qǐ lái  xiǎo lǎo shǔ shén me yě kàn bú jiàn le  tā shēn
Then, Little Mouse couldn't see anything. He stretched out his two hands and asked, "Are you all hidden?"

“cáng hǎo le!” huǒ bàn men dà shēng de huí dá
"Hidden!" the friends shouted back.

xiǎo lǎo shǔ kāi shǐ xún zhǎo huǒ bàn men
Little Mouse began to search for his friends.

tā mō dào dōng biān  huǒ bàn men jiù duǒ dào xī biān
When he touched the east, his friends hid to the west;

tā mō dào nán biān  huǒ bàn men jiù duǒ dào běi biān
When he touched the south, his friends hid to the north.

summary_zh: 小老鼠聪聪和伙伴们在屋里玩捉迷藏，伙伴们蒙住他的眼睛后躲藏起来，聪聪摸索着寻找，但始终找不到他们，这时一阵风吹动了门。

title_en: 83 The Little Mouse with Eyes Covered
page_text_ocr_zh:
开了。小老鼠听到响声，还以为是哪个伙伴躲在那里，他一下子摸出了门和院子，摸到了大街上。

大街上，正好有肥猫经过，他用爪子一把按住了小老鼠。

哈哈

小老鼠也抓住了猫，他高兴地说：“抓住了，抓住了！”

小老鼠揭开蒙在眼睛上的布，看见一只猫爪子正按在自己头上，吓得差点儿昏过去。

那只凶狠的肥猫说：“好运气，看来这是自己送上门的点心，我不客气了！”
page_text_en:
The door opened. The little mouse heard a noise and thought one of his friends was hiding there. He rushed out of the door and yard, and ended up on the street.

On the street, just then a fat cat passed by. He grabbed the little mouse with his paw.

Ha ha

The little mouse also grabbed the cat. He happily said, “Got you, got you!”

The little mouse took off the cloth covering his eyes. He saw a cat’s paw pressing down on his head and was scared almost to faint.

The fierce fat cat said, “What good luck! This must be a treat delivered right to my door. I won’t be polite!”
summary_zh: 小老鼠聪聪在捉迷藏中被伙伴们蒙住眼睛，摸索着出门后被肥猫抓住，但他也抓住了猫，结果发现猫正按在他头上，肥猫得意地认为这是送上门的点心。

title_en: 83 The Little Mouse with Eyes Covered
page_text_ocr_zh:
“当然不用客气！”小老鼠开始镇定下来，他要想办法摆脱这猫的爪子。
小老鼠挥挥手中的布条说：“刚才我和我的伙伴在打赌。我说，蒙上我的眼睛我也能抓住一只猫，可是蒙上一只猫的眼睛，他别想抓住我这只老鼠。”
“你们是这样打赌的吗？”猫生气地说，“我倒要你看看，我这只灵敏的、从来不大话的猫，能不能抓住你这只狂妄的小老鼠！”
“我能用这条布条蒙住你的眼睛吗？”
“当然！”
“蒙得紧一点儿，不是蒙得松一点儿，让你可以偷看到我？”
“什么话，我可不想偷看，蒙得紧一点儿！”
page_text_en:
"Of course, no need to be polite!" The little mouse began to calm down, trying to figure out how to escape the cat's claws.

The little mouse waved the piece of cloth in his hand and said, "Earlier, my friends and I made a bet. I said, if you blindfold me, I can still catch a cat. But if you blindfold the cat, he'll never catch me!"

"Is that how you made your bet?" the cat said angrily. "Well, let me show you. I'm this clever, never-overconfident cat—can I catch you, this arrogant little mouse?"

"Can I use this piece of cloth to blindfold your eyes?"

"Of course!"

"Tie it tight, not loose—so you can't peek!"

"What nonsense! I don't want to peek. Tie it tight!"
summary_zh: 小老鼠在被猫抓住后，用打赌的方式试图摆脱，猫则提出要蒙住小老鼠的眼睛进行挑战，小老鼠坚持要蒙得紧，不能偷看。

title_en: 83 The Little Mouse with Eyes Covered
page_text_ocr_zh:
小老鼠用布条紧紧地蒙住肥猫的眼睛，然后一溜烟地跑回自己家里。
那只被蒙住眼睛的肥猫，一连摸过了三条大街也没有抓住小老鼠……

3、乘秋千旅行的猫
page_text_en:
The little mouse tied a cloth strip tightly over the fat cat's eyes, then dashed back home in a flash.
The fat cat, with his eyes covered, tried to catch the mouse, but even after searching three big streets, he couldn't find him...

3. The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
summary_zh: 小老鼠用布条蒙住肥猫的眼睛后迅速跑回家，肥猫在蒙眼状态下四处摸索却未能抓住小老鼠。右侧页面标题为‘乘秋千旅行的猫’，预示下一个故事。
